description: Capture the viewport, centered on the camera target (an open feature card's view offset is not applied to the capture). The default is a full-size PNG data URL. Optional max_width and scale downscale in the browser before encoding. format is png or jpeg; quality (0 to 1) applies to jpeg only. On the MCP host, save_to or file writes the image to disk and returns { path, size } instead of base64. A missing path (true or "") uses a unique file in the OS temp directory. An existing file is not replaced unless overwrite is true. The path is never sent to the browser.

format.description: Image format. Omit for png, the historical default. jpeg is smaller.

max_width.description: Downscale in the browser so the width is at most this many pixels. Does not upscale.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing file at save_to. Without this, an existing path gets a unique name.

quality.description: jpeg quality from 0 to 1. Ignored for png. Default 0.8.

save_to.description: Write the image on the MCP host and return { path, size } instead of base64. A string is a file path. true or "" uses a unique file in the OS temp directory. Never sent to the browser.

scale.description: Multiply width and height by this factor (0 exclusive to 1). Applied before max_width. Does not upscale.

name: screenshot
